column1: # Java (JDK / third-party) type -> C++ mapping. Consumed by tools/cppgen and implemented by jlang.
# Columns: javaFQN <TAB> cppType <TAB> header <TAB> kind <TAB> notes
#   cppType: C++ type used in declarations. $0,$1 = mapped type arguments (full C++ types,
#            e.g. "Player*", "int32_t"). A missing type argument (raw type / wildcard ?) maps to jlang::Object*.
#   header:  jlang header that declares it ("core" = <jlang/jlang.h>, always included by generated headers).
#   kind:    value     - C++ value type (no pointer)
#            ptr       - GC object held by pointer (class; may be used as base class)
#            static    - utility class with only static members (never a declaration type)
#            exception - exception class (ptr when stored, thrown by value)
#            marker    - marker interface: dropped from base lists
#            unsupported - JVM-only facility; code using it must be rewritten by hand (generator emits jlang::Object* and a comment)
#            codebase  - maps to a class ported from this repository
